translation: Yueren said: The Yang Wei and the Yin Wei are those that connect and bind the body, gathering [qi] with overflow and storing it up, yet unable to circulate it in a ring and irrigate the various vessels. Therefore the Yang Wei arises at the confluence of all the yang, and the Yin Wei arises at the intersection of all the yin. The Yang Wei binds the yang, and the Yin Wei binds the yin; when yin and yang are unable to bind each other, then [the person] is disconsolate and loses his resolve, drifting (rongrong) and unable to gather and control himself.
